description:
🌕 We are Lunar Compass, a team of engineers, innovators, and space enthusiasts building smarter solutions for lunar exploration.

Led by Saifullah, a Computer Engineering student and ICESCO CanSat Symposium delegate, we combine expertise in AI, software, hardware, and FPGA development.

🚀 Our mission: Build an intelligent Lunar Landing Site Navigator to identify safe landing zones using terrain, slope, and crater analysis.
